#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, T;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    cin >> T;
    
    sort(a.begin(), a.end());
    
    int max_count = 0;
    for (int left = 0; left < n; left++) {
        int right = left;
        while (right < n && a[right] - a[left] <= T) {
            right++;
        }
        max_count = max(max_count, right - left);
    }
    
    cout << max_count << endl;
    return 0;
}
